title: Chiral symmetry breaking for large "Nf" and the properties of the "rho" meson near the conformal window
summary: We study how the ground-state properties of the rho meson respond when the number of light-quark flavors N_f is driven towards the conformal window. The interaction is a symmetry-preserving, confining vector--vector contact interaction whose effective coupling carries a flavor dependence designed to encode the screening produced by fermion loops in the deep infrared.
